name: comment-diet
description: Puts agent-written comments on a diet: one line, or none — and one concise summary sentence for a doc comment. A PostToolUse hook (with a Stop backstop) blocks multi-line comment blocks, banners, narration, road-not-taken comments, and the bloated Go doc comments, rustdoc, JSDoc and Python docstrings agents love to pad, in .tf/.yml/.yaml/.sh/.py/.go/.rs/.ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mjs. Scoped to the current change, so pre-existing comments never trip. Ships a writing-comments skill so comments come out lean in the first place, and a /comment-diet:audit command to clean up files that predate the plugin. Configure thresholds, patterns, and excludes in .comment-diet.json. No dependencies.
